messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout: service=reranker, from=redwood/rank-v3.0.1 to=redwood/rank-v3.1.0, target=5% eu-central, rollout_id=rl-4601, change_window=2026-03-24T10:00Z..11:00Z
release-manager: notes: https://go/redwood/releases/3.1.0. Main change: improved scoring heuristics + small attention kernel tweak. QA smoke ok.
rachel: quick ask — is this quantized q4 or fp16? any special runtime flags?
mina: q4_1, and we enable kernel.fast_attn=true for the canary. Docs linked in notes.
tom: SRE, what are the immediate signals we should watch?
sre-oncall: watching p99 latency, 5xxs, and model-failed-allocs. Alert thresholds: 5xx > 0.4% for 8m -> pause. p99 > +60% for 12m -> notify. model-failed-allocs > 3 in 5m -> urgent.
ops: pinning routing to eu-central-1 for the slice to avoid cross-region noise.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 5% eu-central. phase=running.
rachel: seeing a small increase in tail latency on gen-svc-proxy logs. p99 ~ +45%. Not yet at threshold.
sre-oncall: checking traces — a subset of requests hitting host=re-ranker-4 show repeated memory-retries. Sample:
```
[2026-03-24T10:05:33Z] req=7a2b mem_retry=true retry_count=2 host=re-ranker-4
```
tom: could be queuing due to concurrency spike. Can we temporarily lower canary concurrency?
mina: propose concurrency override to 6 and reduce batch_limit to 1 for the canary.
deploy-bot: applying overrides={concurrency:6,batch_limit:1} for rl-4601.
ops: applying infra-level kube-limit for re-ranker pods in eu-central now.
sre-oncall: after overrides p99 down to +18%, mem_retry logs reduced. 5xx stable at 0.12%.
release-manager: recommend HOLD at 5% for next 20m and sync at +20m. No PM rollback request.
rachel: also adding a soft-flag to disable kernel.fast_attn for canary to compare. Can we toggle?
deploy-bot: runtime flag updated: canary.kernel.fast_attn=false for rl-4601.
mina: ran quick internal eval — ranking deltas minimal. Good.
sre-oncall: alerting configured: auto-rollback if model-failed-allocs >3 in 5m OR 5xx >0.5% for 6m. Playbook posted to #eng-oncall.
tom: FYI, if we see re-ranker restarts >2 in 10m, we'll hit an infra mitigation to cordon node group.
ops: noted; cordon policy ready.
release-manager: marking status: THROTTLED at 5% pending 10:20Z check. If stable, ramp to 20%. If someone wants immediate rollback, reply with "rollback".
mina: ack. I'll follow up to revert kernel changes if we see any regression.
sre-oncall: monitoring. will escalate to infra if restarts spike.
deploy-bot: phase=paused (manual_hold) rollout_id=rl-4601 current_pct=5 note=concurrency-limited+flag-toggled.
release-manager: thanks team. next check 10:20Z or earlier on signal. :white_check_mark:
